why: #35166: WindowRootView re-lays out its titlebar when the window's backing scale changes (a move to a display with another scale changes no bounds, so pixel-aligned titlebar frames kept half-point edges). The override has to be on WindowRootView, the App's titlebar host; the alignment math stays in CmuxNextDesign (WindowTitlebar.alignedFrame).
